prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: the actual square 2048x2048 UV ALBEDO SKIN for the UTILITY SUV.
Image 1 is the exact registered texture to edit. Image 2 is the approved vehicle concept sheet; use ONLY blue SUV C as the painting/style reference. Repaint image 1 in place without moving, scaling, changing or rearranging any existing windows, door seams, handles, arch curves, lamp features or regions. Output a production flat UV texture, NOT a new illustration of an SUV, NOT a 3D render, NOT a turnaround.
Preserve layout exactly: upper strip is the SIDE texture with THREE side windows (rear quarter window at left, rear-door window at middle, front-door window at right), exactly TWO door handles and two wheel-arch curves. Middle region is the long TOP skin with ONE trapezoid windscreen at RIGHT; the rest is plain covered roof/bonnet paint. There is NO glass at the left of the middle region. Bottom-left is the FRONT, with cream lamps, grille, amber indicators and black bumper; bottom-right is the REAR, with ONE wide hatch window above the hatch, a painted rear wiper, two vertical red tail lamps at left/right, and black bumper below. Keep every feature precisely registered and leave no holes or transparent areas.
Paint the same rich restrained gouache/oil material treatment as approved SUV C: brushwork following panel directions, nuanced enamel planes, soft fender crowns along existing arch guides, fine shut-line shadow, thin worn highlight rims, practical black trim, subtly scratched bonnet/roof, small hand-painted ochre/rust chips at lower edges, wheel arches, door seams and hatch sill. Large enamel areas stay quiet and coherent; avoid giant diagonal brush patches, camo patterns, or photographic noise.
IMPORTANT: make the enamel a LIGHT NEUTRAL warm ivory-gray base, NOT blue, since the game applies petrol blue, sage or oxide tint. Paint the glass desaturated dark blue-gray with hand-painted cloudy-sky reflections, dark interior shapes and black seals. Rubber is charcoal, steel dull gray, headlights warm cream, indicators amber, tail lamps muted red. Render details into the skin including handles, hatch recesses, grille mesh/slats, lamp lens ribs and rubber bumper wear. No shiny showroom finish, no photo-realism, no extra badges or text.
Even diffuse albedo surface shading only, no ground plane, cast shadows, view labels, frame, new margins or perspective. Keep the exact square canvas, unusual UV proportions and all blank surface coverage of image 1. Strict registration is essential.
